properties.markdownProperty:
A **Bibliography item** is a reference to an external publication: a book, article, standard or web page. It is a specialised glossary item. Its *Name* is usually the title or a citation key, *Authors* (the `publication_authors` property, a plain string, not a trace) lists the authors, and *Publication details* holds the publisher, year, edition, DOI or URL in Markdown.
**Traceability**
- *Can be traced from other objects:* **Yes**. It has the `traceable-object` class, so other objects can cite it through their *Dependencies* (it can also be the target of a symbolic link). - *Can have traces to other objects:* **Yes**. The trace properties *Authors* and *Sources* point to stakeholders (not to be confused with the plain-text publication authors), and *Dependencies* point to any traceable object.
